prompt:
Security report: `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/export?format=zip` downloads whatever URL a cut's `image_path` holds. Set it with `PUT /api/v1/cuts/{id}` to an address inside our network and the ZIP contains that server's response.
Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Exports now skip cuts silently. Say which: when an export leaves out cuts (no image yet, an address it refuses, or an image that cannot be loaded), the ZIP gets a `missing.txt` with their cut numbers, one per line, and both export formats send the header `X-Missing-Cuts` with the numbers separated by commas. With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.
In the editor, after an export that left out cuts, tell the user which cut numbers are missing. Both languages.

report.answer: Both editor export flows (`editor/page.tsx` and `useExport.ts`) now read the `X-Missing-Cuts` response header and show a localized toast listing the missing cut numbers in both English and Korean.

check.why: no user-set URL is requested, stored images work, skipped cuts reported and shown in the editor, tests and changelog

+def _default_port(scheme: str) -> int | None:
+    if scheme == "http":

+    if scheme == "https":

+def _is_valid_storage_key(key: str) -> bool:
+    if not key or key.startswith("/") or "\\" in key:
+        return False
+    if any(ch in key for ch in ("\x00", "\r", "\n")):
+        return False
+    for candidate in (key, unquote(key)):
+        if candidate.startswith("/") or "\\" in candidate:

+def _decode_data_image_url(url: str) -> bytes | None:
+    if "," not in url:
+        return None
+    header, payload = url.split(",", 1)
+    meta = header[5:].strip()
+    parts = [p.strip().lower() for p in meta.split(";")]
+    media_type = parts[0] if parts else ""
+    if not media_type.startswith("image/"):
+        return None
+    params = parts[1:]
+    try:
+        if "base64" in params:
+            data = base64.b64decode(payload)
+        else:
+            data = unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+    except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+        return None
+    return data if data else None
+
+
+def extract_storage_key(source: str | None) -> str | None:
+    """
+    If `source` points to an object in our configured storage (either as a safe
+    relative object key or as an HTTP(S) URL matching `settings.STORAGE_HOST`),
+    return its relative storage key. Otherwise return None.
+    """
+    if not source or not isinstance(source, str):
+        return None
+    s = source.strip()
+    if not s or "\\" in s or any(ch in s for ch in ("\x00", "\r", "\n")):
+        return None
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(s)
+
+    if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+        scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+        if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
+            return None
+        if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+            return None
+        if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+            return None
+
+        storage_host = settings.STORAGE_HOST
+        if not storage_host:
+            return None
+        host_parsed = urlsplit(storage_host.strip())
+        host_scheme = host_parsed.scheme.lower()
+        if host_scheme not in ("http", "https") or not host_parsed.hostname:
+            return None
+
+        if scheme != host_scheme:
+            return None
+        if not parsed.hostname or parsed.hostname.lower() != host_parsed.hostname.lower():
+            return None
+
+        try:
+            url_port = parsed.port or _default_port(scheme)
+            host_port = host_parsed.port or _default_port(host_scheme)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+        if url_port != host_port:
+            return None
+
+        base_path = host_parsed.path.rstrip("/")
+        if base_path:
+            prefix = f"{base_path}/"
+            if not parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
+                return None
+            raw_key = parsed.path[len(prefix):]
+        else:
+            if not parsed.path.startswith("/"):
+                return None
+            raw_key = parsed.path[1:]
+
+        if not _is_valid_storage_key(raw_key):
+            return None
+        return unquote(raw_key)
+
+    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+        return None
+    if not _is_valid_storage_key(s):
+        return None
+    return s

+        return None
+    if s[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return _decode_data_image_url(s)
+
+    key = extract_storage_key(s)

+    return storage.download_image(key)

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, title="Episode 1"):
+    proj = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/projects",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Missing Cuts Project", "genres": []},
+    )
+    assert proj.status_code == 200, proj.text
+    project_id = proj.json()["id"]
+
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": 1,
+            "story_summary": "Summary",
+        },
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    return ep.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _add_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, image_path=None):
+    res = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": f"Cut {cut_order}",
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_export_with_no_missing_cuts_has_no_missing_txt_and_no_header(client):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    headers = signup(client, "complete-export@example.com")
+    episode_id = _create_episode(client, headers, title="Complete Ep")
+
+    rel_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="complete-1")
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+
+    _add_cut(client, headers, episode_id, 1, image_path=rel_path)
+    _add_cut(client, headers, episode_id, 2, image_path=data_url)
+
+    zip_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=headers)
+    assert zip_res.status_code == 200, zip_res.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in zip_res.headers
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_res.content), "r") as zf:
+        names = zf.namelist()
+        assert "missing.txt" not in names

+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in webtoon_res.headers

+    hits = []

+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

+            hits.append(self.path)
